review_candidates.title: Backend Engineer III
review_candidates.description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍London or UK Remote | 💰 Engineer III Compensation: £85,000 - £110,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology About Our Engineering Teams We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company. These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities. How We Work 💻 Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨ Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️ Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online. Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life: At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨ If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance. Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼 You Should Apply If you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.). you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing We're on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Be Working On We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge , you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here) Cassandra for most persistent data storage Kafka for our asynchronous message queue Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services Envoy Proxy for RPC AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure React for our public web apps and internal tools We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties The Interview Process Our interview process involves three main stages: Initial Call Take home task or pair coding exercise Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here . What’s In It For You 💰 £85,000 - £110,000 base salary + Incentive Awards tied to your performance ✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK ✅ We can sponsor visas. 📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London). ⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. 📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences ➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job. Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

review_candidates.title: Data engineer / Data architect (Senior)
review_candidates.description: EOS is part of The EOS Group — a leading technology-driven investor in receivables portfolios and an expert in the processing of outstanding receivables. With over 50 years of experience and offices in more than 20 countries, EOS offers intelligent receivables management services worldwide. At EOS Romania, you'll be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous growth — through innovation challenges, cross-border projects, and the people around you. THE ROLE We are looking for a senior data engineer / data architect to lead the redesign of our data warehouse. The focus is on critically assessing our existing high-volume data infrastructure, understanding the business logic embedded in it, and re-modelling it to better serve collections, recovery, and portfolio reporting. The right person combines deep technical command of Oracle and modern data architectures with the ability to understand why the data is structured the way it is — and to improve it without breaking the business processes that depend on it. RESPONSIBILITIES Assess the existing data warehouse — identify structural, performance, and design weaknesses — and lead its redesign Re-model the warehouse across conceptual, logical, and physical layers to better reflect business processes and reporting needs Define and execute the migration strategy, ensuring continuity of critical reporting throughout the transition Administer and optimize Oracle databases, with planned expansion toward PostgreSQL Design and tune complex queries — SQL tuning, execution plan analysis, indexing and partitioning strategies Translate requirements from business and analytics stakeholders into data structures, and advise on what the data genuinely supports Apply data privacy, access control, and anonymization by design across all warehouse and pipeline work Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance monitoring of the redesigned system REQUIREMENTS Advanced SQL — Oracle is mandatory; PostgreSQL is a strong plus Proven experience designing or redesigning data warehouses, including data modelling (conceptual, logical, physical) Demonstrated ability to understand the business logic behind existing data structures and reconcile it with an improved technical design Strong database performance optimization skills — query optimization, partitioning, indexing Experience with high-volume / high-throughput systems Solid knowledge of data architectures: Data Warehousing and Data Lakes Experience with data integration and processing tools (ETL/ELT) Experience working with sensitive / personal data and applying data-protection practices Hands-on experience with a cloud database platform (Azure preferred; AWS a plus) Knowledge of analytics / predictive modelling is a plus PROFILE Strong analytical mindset, with the judgment to challenge existing designs and propose better ones Comfortable owning a problem end to end — from understanding the business need through to architecture, build, and migration Able to communicate technical trade-offs (performance, cost, maintainability) clearly to non-technical stakeholders Pragmatic about balancing an ideal design against operational continuity and delivery constraints WHAT WE OFFER Flexible working hours Meal tickets Medical insurance subscription 21 days of annual leave 1 additional leave day for each year with the company 1 additional leave day on your birthday In-house and off-site team events Hackathon & Wall of Fame — EOS Group international innovation competition Gift tickets for special occasions (Christmas, Easter, Children's Day) Apply today and become part of EOS Romania's data transformation journey. Changing finances for the better.

review_candidates.description: About the Company The role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and enhancing applications for First American. These applications are typically web-based and are developed in accordance with established coding standards and guidelines using a continuous Build-Integrate-Test approach within an Agile environment. About the Role Software Engineer II — Full Stack Location: Remote Role overview The Software Engineer II will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Architect, Product Manager and team to understand both stated and unstated needs and translate complex functional requirements into clear system requirements. The Software Engineer II will use a strong understanding of the business domain and software development practices to improve the functionality, performance, reliability, and maintainability of software applications. Responsibilities Contribute across the full software development lifecycle—from requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of web-based applications. Develop a sound understanding of the business, product, and domain; use that knowledge to recommend functional improvements and enhancements. Translate functional and business requirements into technical and system requirements; identify technical blind spots and clarify ambiguity in ideas and designs. Work with the Engineering Manager, Architect, and Product Manager to align on team goals; prioritize effectively and propose scope adjustments when necessary. Take ownership of assigned modules and independently develop features; act with urgency to deliver high-quality work that adds value to the business and stakeholders. Create basic project plans for small projects and development initiatives. Follow organizational coding standards, development guidelines, quality assurance standards, and configuration management practices. Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback; improve team processes, code, and work items. Develop an understanding of production infrastructure, application interfaces, integrations, and product dependencies. Participate in core team and Agile ceremonies; question the status quo and recommend practical improvements to team processes. Build relationships across teams and communicate requirements with partner groups to achieve positive outcomes. Ask questions, learn from others, receive feedback humbly, and seek help or decision support when needed. Key responsibilities Understands and meets the stated needs and requirements of stakeholders. Considers contextual and business nuances while delivering solutions and works as a trusted partner to stakeholders. Understands the importance of delivering work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards and raises concerns when deviations occur. Takes initiative to develop technical and behavioral skills. Reflects on and learns from personal experiences and the experiences of others. Is receptive to new ideas and different perspectives. Works with focus to achieve assigned goals and targets. Seeks regular feedback and recommends ways to improve the efficiency and quality of work. Breaks complex problems into smaller components, evaluates available information, and selects an appropriate course of action. review_candidates.title: Metrology Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary General Atomics (GA), and its affiliated companies, is one of the world’s leading resources for high-technology systems development ranging from the nuclear fuel cycle to remotely piloted aircraft, airborne sensors, and advanced electric, electronic, wireless and laser technologies. General Atomics Advanced Fabrication Technology in Torrey Pines is seeking a Software Engineer with 5–10 years of experience and a strong background in dimensional metrology and coordinate measuring machines (CMMs). This role focuses on developing and supporting software solutions that interface with CMM equipment and metrology systems used in advanced fabrication, inspection, and production environments. The position is predominantly onsite (90%) to enable close collaboration with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams and hands-on work with metrology equipment. Duties & Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain software tools and applications that support metrology and CMM inspection workflows for advanced fabrication programs. Integrate CMMs and other metrology equipment with internal systems (e.g., databases, MES, PLM, or ERP) to streamline data collection, traceability, and reporting. Develop and maintain interfaces, scripts, and automation routines to improve CMM programming efficiency and inspection throughput. Work with manufacturing, quality, and design engineering to translate GD&T and inspection requirements into robust, repeatable software and measurement solutions. Develop automated reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools for measurement and inspection data. Troubleshoot software and system issues related to CMM operation, data transfer, and metrology applications. Participate in code reviews, configuration management, and documentation of software designs, test plans, and user instructions. Support validation, verification, and testing of new or modified metrology software and CMM processes. Provide technical support and training to engineers, technicians, and operators on metrology-related software tools and workflows. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. Job Qualifications Typically requires a bachelors degree, masters degree or PhD in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution and progressive engineering experience as follows; four or more years of experience with a bachelors degree or two or more years of experience with a masters degree. May substitute equivalent engineering experience in lieu of education. Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent experience. Hands-on experience with metrology and CMM equipment (operation, programming support, or data integration). Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering environments (such as C#, C++, Python, or similar). Experience working with databases (SQL or NoSQL) and data structures for measurement/inspection data. Working knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and how it applies to inspection and measurement. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams on the shop floor and in lab environments. Ability and willingness to work onsite at least 90% of the time at the Torrey Pines facility. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CMM programming or CMM software environments (e.g., QUINDOS, PC-DMIS, Calypso, or similar). Direct experience programming in QUINDOS is a strong plus. Experience automating inspection routines, macros, or scripting for CMMs. Experience in aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated industries. Familiarity with configuration management, version control (e.g., Git), and standard software development lifecycle practices. Experience with statistical analysis of measurement data (e.g., GR&R, capability studies, SPC) and associated tools. Active Q Clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain a Q Clearance. Additional Requirements Must be a U.S. Person as defined by applicable export control regulations. Must be able to work in controlled and secure environments as required. Must be able to occasionally lift and move equipment or fixtures associated with metrology setups, as applicable. Job Type: Full-Time Salary Salary range: 81,080 - 141,650
